tool.name: alibaba/open-code-review
tool.configIdentity: delegation mode (OCR_LLM_* and ANTHROPIC_* unset; OCR never contacted an LLM endpoint); deterministic preview and rule resolution re-run at head bd8b40d on the repository-local candidate clone; rule source system

separateReviews.method: Separate review of the excluded test oracle: every added assertion was checked against the contract it pins rather than against the implementation, covering the declared privacy vocabularies and their derived subsets (user-visible consent and visibility, public visibility, redaction controls), the processing-purpose list and its malformed forms, every declared policy value accepted with privacy-neutral companion attributes, out-of-vocabulary privacy values reported once as vocabulary violations, both directions of the consent/visibility rule, the redaction-control rule with its declared, absent, and malformed cases, the public-visibility rule with its classification and visibility negative cases including a policy that governs nothing, deterministic reporting across node and edge order, mutation-freedom with unchanged canonical revision identity, the governance phase as the final phase, and fail-closed handling of an undeclared privacy-adjacent attribute.

findings.rationale: A policy that requires audit or minimization and declares a malformed redaction value reports only the vocabulary violation. The document still fails closed, one offending value yields one complaint, and the suppression is pinned by a focused test.

Public visibility is only reported when the policy governs data whose classification requires a handling policy. A policy that governs nothing exposes nothing, and the accepted boundary is pinned by a focused test.
